solution.text:
First we will find the sample space in which the number of five-digit numbers are divisible by 5,

So, fixing zero at the last place we get,

Now in first four place following number can take place,

2244→4!2!2!=6 ways

2241→4!2!=12 ways

So, total sample space will be 4+6+4+12+12=38 

Now finding the number of favourable outcomes,

So, Number of five-digit numbers divisible by 5 but 'not' by 20

Now fixing 10 in last two places, we get

So, total number of numbers which are divisible by 5 but not 20 will be, 1+3+3=7

So, favourable number of five-digit numbers that are divisible by 5 and 20=38-7=31
